description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'Credit' within the Opencart namespace, specifically extending from the Opencart System Engine Model. The class manages the total related functionalities for credit within the OpenCart extension system, including methods to get totals, confirm transactions, and unconfirm transactions related to customer credit.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: A class managing customer credit totals in OpenCart, including retrieving total credit, confirming credit transactions, and unconfirming transactions.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adjusts the total based on customer credit balance, adding a credit total entry if applicable.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Records a credit transaction for a customer upon order confirmation.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes a recorded credit transaction when an order is unconfirmed.
